evals.prompt: Create a skill called pdf-analyzer that extracts tables from PDF files and outputs them as CSV. I've been doing this manually with pdfplumber and always have to remember the page.extract_tables() call.
evals.expected_output: A .claude/skills/pdf-analyzer/ directory with SKILL.md (frontmatter, 5-step workflow, Hard Rules, Gotchas), reference/workflow.md, evals/evals.json with 2+ test cases, and a description that triggers on PDF/table extraction prompts.
assertions: SKILL.md contains PREFLIGHT, EXPLORE, AUTHOR, VALIDATE, CLOSEOUT steps
SKILL.md has a Hard Rules section
evals/evals.json exists with at least 2 test cases
description contains trigger phrases related to PDF and tables

evals.prompt: My webwright skill never activates when I ask it to automate a web form. The description just says 'Automate web tasks'. Can you refine it?
evals.expected_output: Updated description in .claude/skills/webwright/SKILL.md that is more specific about trigger conditions, includes proxy phrases like 'fill out', 'submit', 'scrape', and has been tested against should-trigger and should-not-trigger queries.
assertions: SKILL.md description is updated (not the original 'Automate web tasks')
Updated description contains more specific trigger phrases
description-testing eval queries were written and pass rate checked

evals.prompt: Audit all skills in .claude/skills/ and tell me which ones have hard findings.
evals.expected_output: A report listing each skill, its check results (A01-A12), and a summary of hard vs soft findings. Skills with hard findings are identified.
assertions: Each finding has an ID (A01-A12), PASS/FAIL status
Hard finding count is reported per skill
Skills with exit code 1 (hard findings) are clearly flagged
